steps.name: Oakley?
steps.text: Shit, bro, take my name if you want, but you didn't have to steal my entire past!

steps.name: Oakley!
steps.text: How dare you slander me! I wrote the entire application myself!

steps.name: Oakley?
steps.text: Can you recite it from memory?

steps.name: Oakley!
steps.text: H-How am I supposed to pull something I wrote a year ago from memory?

steps.name: Oakley?
steps.text: 'Oakley, born in Bunkerhill, graduate of Trimounts College of Arts and Science, previously worked as a guide in the Human Development and Technological Inovation Department of the District Convention Center...'

steps.name: Oakley?
steps.text: 'Innovation' is misspelled.

steps.name: Oakley!
steps.text: You! Damn you, if I didn't lose my terminal and CV—

a.text: Gordon's head has never hurt so badly.
The holes in the onboarding process are obvious upon further inspection. But the real question is—
Why would she impersonate a guide?
Is she a Leithanian spy? A DOD agent? Or a pair of eyes that D.C. is keeping on him?
The impostor has already made contact with many corporations at the preview exhibition. Dealing with her now means broadcasting his negligence to the whole country.
Besides, Gordon has no idea how much she knows, and whether she has ill intentions towards him and Columbia...

steps.text: Gordon does not dare to think about it any further.

steps.name: Oakley?
steps.text: Your gaze wanders when you speak. Your voice is trembling, and you talk without rhyme or reason.

steps.name: Oakley?
steps.text: I doubt Mr. Tannen would want such an 'Oakley' to handle promotion work.

steps.name: Oakley!
steps.text: Don't bring Mr. Tannen into this! I tell you—

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Shut up!

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Perhaps you need a little time to calm down, 'Mister' Oakley. Come with me to the reception room to rest for a while.

steps.name: Oakley?
steps.text: Mr. Tannen, I...

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Listen up. I just pulled your activity records from the park here. It won't be hard to figure out just who you are.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: One more lie, and I'm throwing you off this plate. It won't matter who you are when you're a puddle on the ground six hundred meters down. You get me?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Now talk. Who are you?

steps.name: Oakley?
steps.text: ...A guide.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: You got balls, I'll give you that.

steps.name: Oakley?
steps.text: Th-The kind of guide the tourists need!

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: My name is Ferne. I-I'm a tour guide.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: My apologies, Mr. Oakley. Mr. Tannen will make sure that this matter is dealt with promptly.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Do you believe me now?

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Of course. You can reach me through this terminal if you need anything. Now, get some rest. I'll be going.

steps.name: Oakley
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Done.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Read the room and avert potential risks for your boss...

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Another rule for secretaries.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: You said Oakley got himself drunk a month ago after a breakup, and he gave you his resume instead of his contact info, which gave you a chance to sneak into Propeller Paradise under his identity?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Your client was an old Banshee who somehow got lost in the Bleached Wasteland. Her memory was hazy and it was difficult to communicate with her?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: You suspected that she was ill, and you were asking around under the guise of a guide to make her journey a smooth one, which is why you looked like you were up to something?

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: Exactly!

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: You've spent a whole month here. You know this is no ordinary place. If you're a foreign spy, the military take you in for questioning, torture, and you'll never again see the light of day.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: If you're an agent from the Department of Defense, D.C. won't let you off the hook. They'll disavow, distort, and even dispose of you, all for the sake of tipping the scales to their side.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: If you're a District plant, then you've learned too much, and ATAO taught me plenty of ways to help you 'forget'.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: But you're just a tour guide who cares for her client. You're a good person.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: And Columbia will do good by a good person.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: You aren't going to press charges?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Believe me, I'd love to, but too many corporations have noticed your performance at the pre-expo. You'll deal with your problems and get lost before they find out who you are.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: The longer you stay, the more I have to compensate the poor guy whose name you stole. If all you want to do is to clear the mind of your Banshee client, I can help.

steps.name: Ferne
steps.text: You know about Banshees?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I know how to solve your problem.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Floating botanical unit connected.

steps.name: Veteran Researcher
steps.text: Bioelectrical signal detected. Charging drive unit.

steps.name: Veteran Researcher
steps.text: Phew... that's the smoothest these experiments have gone, isn't it?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: No, this voice... the short-circuit protection has kicked in.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: (In Sarkaz) Unravel.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: (In Sarkaz) Unravel!

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Veteran Researcher
steps.text: You shouldn't touch an overloaded converter with your bare hands, Director!

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Works better than an incantation. How are the readings?

steps.name: Veteran Researcher
steps.text: By exhibition standards, the technology for high-altitude energy transmission through plants is sufficiently mature. By the standards of your expectations for the project, however...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Not good enough. The energy transmission threshold for the floating botanical unit falls short of theoretical values.

steps.name: Veteran Researcher
steps.text: That prickly Forte kid would chill out a bit if you said as much to him...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Sky is inexperienced, but he was right about one thing—this Vivarium is Kristen's legacy, and we owe it to her to do our best.

steps.name: Veteran Researcher
steps.text: You were always stubborn, going back to when we dug out the S.H.A.F.T. together five years ago.

steps.name: Veteran Researcher
steps.text: You pulled all-nighters to ensure its structural integrity, enchanting the core materials with incantations. Nothing could get you to take a break, not even your favorite gummy worms.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: If you want to go fincatching, do it at Lake Sulligan. Assuming I approve your leave request, of course.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Besides, I worked so many hours just because I was inefficient. I learned to write curses too late. My incantations suffer in strength and precision compared to my kindred, because they rely on sound as the sole medium.

steps.name: Veteran Researcher
steps.text: Is that why you modified your bone pen and use hole-punched paper tapes to supplement your casting?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Yes. I took a lot of wrong turns.
Nasti takes out her bone pen, a plain, unornamented object resembling Rhine's technological creations.
She inserts it into a sapling in the Vivarium, and a white glow rises from the roots, through the branches and into every leaf.
It is as though a command has been entered into the whole Vivarium; terminals begin to execute programs, automatically recording plant energy conversion data.

steps.name: Veteran Researcher
steps.text: Such an efficient programming language, your incantations...

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Then, we should make more efficient decisions at this bottleneck, despite the risks.

steps.name: Veteran Researcher
steps.text: Do you mean...?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Review the report again. Thank you for your work.

steps.name: Veteran Researcher
steps.text: Yes, ma'am.

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Hello, this is the Rhine Vivarium Lab.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Hello, Director Lunorey. Mr. Tannen has asked me to express his gratitude at your reasonable accommodation that led to successful cooperation the last time.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: There are some follow-up matters to be discussed. Do you have time this afternoon?

steps.name: Nasti
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Mercia
steps.text: Excellent. I will see you in the Vivarium in an hour.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Ride the ropeway to Flying Donut station, then take the ring corridor...

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: I'm in the right place, aren't I? It's dark in here. Where's the light...?

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Good heavens... wh-where am I?!

steps.name: Unknown Entity
steps.text: Intruder alert, intruder alert.

steps.name: Unknown Entity
steps.text: Activating bio-scan. Analyzing results. Species: Terran. Sex: Male. Threat level: Pending.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: A-A talking finbeast?

steps.name: Space Finbeast
steps.text: Mind your words, foolish Terran! I am Space Fin 054. State your Universe ID number, immediately!

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Universe ID...?

steps.name: Space Finbeast
steps.text: (Whisper) Your corporate name, nitwit!

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Oh, uh, Lucky Cystybeast Food and Beverage.

steps.name: Space Finbeast
steps.text: Ah, so you are the partner that 'Sky Conqueror' was expecting. How unfortunate that I won't get the chance to test my laser cannons.

steps.name: Space Finbeast
steps.text: (Whisper) Don't touch anything. The supervisor will be here momentarily.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Supervisor?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Five-Four, make sure you speak like an extraterrestrial entity next time you do the client explanation thing.

steps.name: Space Finbeast
steps.text: Aye aye, sir.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: M-Mr. Tannen?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Shh—don't huff and puff. The polite thing to do when you stand in this collection of unique curiosities, the likes of which you will not find anywhere else in Terra, is to admire it with your eyes.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Look at the wall on your right. Five years ago, I confiscated the possessions of a pioneer trying to illegally cross the border, and found an unusual water circulation and filtration system in his trailer.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: He helped me find the core component in exchange for looking the other way. When the unit was assembled, I identified it as a Locus of Sorcery—a Sarkaz witchcraft weapon.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: My goodness, it must be dangerous...

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Turn around and look behind you. This is a trident Arts unit from Leithanien, created by Witch King cultists who wanted to amplify Arts output so they could rip apart the fabric of reality and summon their master.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Kinda crazy, sure, but its conversion efficiency is fifty times the max allowed by Propeller Paradise regulations. Even an onion could fly with it.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: Wait, so you solved One-Boot's technical issues with... contraband?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Contraband? ATAO made up the stupid rule about only using parts made in Columbia!

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: I don't know and I don't care about the reasons behind the decisions. All I know is that these rules are un-Columbian. They restrict scientists, and force entrepreneurs to lie!

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: It was a single humble ATAO officer who imported inventions from across Terra into Propeller Paradise, forming the heart and soul of one-third of all levitating facilities here.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: One-third... you've run hundreds of smuggling operations without getting exposed?

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Every transaction, every deal has gone without a hitch under my management. Not even my secretary Merry knows my secrets.

steps.name: Aspen
steps.text: I... I need time to think about this, Mr. Tannen...

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Lucky Cystybeast has one day left, and I got other things on my plate. I'll give you five seconds.

steps.name: Gordon
steps.text: Lucky Cystybeast gets a mongrel heart, or you let it die to your stubborn pride. Choose.
